# variable-star designation, so the pipeline cannot key the orbit to a
# entry's components before orphan sub-pair synthesis; the mapping is
# per (wds_id, discoverer) exactly as parse_orb6 strips them.
#   discoverer  — ORB6 discoverer cell, stripped (e.g. "YY Gem").
#   components  — WDS component letters the orbit belongs to.
#   source      — literature reference for the identification.
